verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's CLI supports fully headless, non-interactive plan/apply/destroy workflows with exit codes and machine-readable JSON output, enabling external automation/agent pipelines to drive it (opentofu-probe-5,6,7). However, OpenTofu itself has no built-in scheduler, trigger, or background daemon for autonomous execution—it must be invoked and orchestrated by an external system (CI/CD, cron, agent runner), so 'autonomous background automation' is only achievable indirectly.
